y-m-76-01.s.s1.line.4: Rasiidhyada kale sidoo kale, ka jarista 10% wadarta waxay bixisaa qiimaha VAT ka hor, sidaas darteed si la mid ah ayaan u xisaabin karnaa.
y-m-76-01.s.s1.explain: Khadka 2 ayaa ugu horreeya ee khaldama. VAT 10% waa 10% qiimaha VAT ka hor, maaha wadarta. Khadadka 3 iyo 4 waxay sii wataan qiimaha khadka 2, hubinta khadka 4-na waxay u soo baxday mid ka duwan wadarta (32,670 won). y-m-76-01.s.s2.prompt: Waa maxay habka ugu habboon ee loo helo qiimaha VAT ka hor wadarta 33,000 won?
y-m-76-01.s.s2.hint.0: Qiimaha VAT ka hor ka dhig hal xaraf (tusaale x) oo isleeg ku qor sida wadarta loogu muujiyo x.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.hint.1: Hubi haddii ku darista 10% VAT mar kale qiime musharrax ah ay bixiso 33,000 won.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.r.a: 10% marka kor loo qaado waxay salka ku haysaa qiimaha VAT ka hor, 10% marka hoos loo dhigo-na waxay salka ku haysaa wadarta, sidaas darteed qaddarrada way kala duwan yihiin. Mar kale ku dar VAT qiimaha aad heshay oo hubi haddii aad hesho wadarta.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.r.b: Xisaabtani waxay VAT ku daraysaa wadarta mar kale. Qiimaha VAT ka hor waa inuu ka yar yahay wadarta.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.o.c: Wadarta waa 1.1 jeer qiimaha VAT ka hor, sidaas darteed wadarta u qaybi 1.1.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.o.d: Haddii aadan ogayn qiimaha VAT ka hor, ma heli kartid VAT sidoo kale, sidaas darteed lagama xisaabin karo wadarta keligeed.
y-m-76-01.s.s2.r.d: Waad heli kartaa adigoo qiimaha VAT ka hor u arkaya mid aan la aqoon oo dejinaya isleegga "wadarta = qiimaha VAT ka hor × 1.1".
y-m-76-01.s.s2.explain: Wadarta = qiimaha VAT ka hor + 10% qiimaha VAT ka hor = qiimaha VAT ka hor × 1.1. Sidaas darteed qiimaha VAT ka hor = 33,000 ÷ 1.1 = 30,000 won iyo VAT waa 3,000 won. y-m-76-01.s.s3.selfAssess.0: Ma hubisay in ku dabaqidda heerkaaga wadarta 33,000 won ay ka tagto qiimaha VAT ka hor 30,000 won?

y-m-76-01.s.s3.model.0: VAT 3,000 won waxay ka kooban tahay 3,000 ÷ 33,000 = ku dhawaad 9.1% wadarta 33,000 won. 10% waxay salka ku haysaa qiimaha VAT ka hor, haddii wadartu tahay salka, waa ka yar tahay 10%.
y-m-76-01.s.s3.model.1: Haddii aad ka jarto hal meel oo kow iyo tobnaad wadarta (ku dhawaad 9.1%), waxaad heleysaa qiimaha VAT ka hor.
